name: Break: The Rematch
source:
Young college student Shinn Akatsuki returns to his high school as an adviser for the underperforming mathematics student, at the apparent request of the principal. Although an impeccable and courteous man on the outside, Shinn hides a very dark side to him: as part of his unending perversion, he enjoys seeing girls that he considers "out of everyone's league" succumb to him.  Never satisfied before, however, he discarded his past victims. But now, Shinn decides to create his "ultimate sex harem", and with these dark thoughts in mind, and selects the candidates he considers "ideal" as he becomes acquainted with the school: the star of the track and field team, the innocent and tomboyish Makoto Shinjugai, the rich and spoiled tennis player Ritsuko Yasuhiro, the graceful, serious and traditional Satsuki Katsuragi, the swimming team's promising, dutiful and charming Aina Aozaki, and the basketball star, Touko Takatsukasa. As he begins his "hunt", Shinn also adds gymnastics instructor Rina Akiyama to his lust after she impresses him with her luscious body and maturity.

And thus, under the pretense of a "responsible adviser" and the help of his one remaining past sex lover, professor Reika Tohno, the protagonist's wicked quest to create his ideal sex harem begins...

[From [url=https://pushpublication.itch.io/break-the-rematch-part-1/]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻大学生赤月真回到高中，担任数学成绩不佳学生的辅导员，表面上是校长的请求。虽然他表面上无可挑剔、彬彬有礼，却隐藏着极其阴暗的一面：作为无尽变态欲望的一部分，他喜欢看那些被自己认为“高不可攀”的女孩向自己屈服。过去他从未得到满足，总会抛弃曾经的受害者；但这一次，真决定建立自己的“终极性爱后宫”。怀着这些阴暗想法，他在熟悉学校的过程中挑选理想对象：田径队明星、新手且假小子的真城真琴；富有又被宠坏的网球选手安広律子；优雅、认真而传统的葛城五月；游泳队前途无量、认真迷人的青崎爱奈；以及篮球明星高司透子。开始“狩猎”后，真又被体操教练秋山莉奈丰润的身体与成熟气质打动，将她加入欲望名单。

于是，在“负责的辅导员”这一假面以及仅存的旧日性伴侣远野玲香教授的帮助下，主人公建立理想性爱后宫的邪恶计划开始了……
